description: Assign a defensible severity to a finding — build the CVSS 3.1 vector from demonstrated impact and reconcile it with the program's own scale. Load on "what severity", "CVSS", "rate this bug", or before submitting a report. Signals: a confirmed finding needing a score, a program VRT/severity policy, a severity dispute.
